verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live llms.txt at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com that indexes the Mesh guides. Docs pages are served as raw markdown, and their frontmatter includes an `agentTools.projectIndex` pointer back to llms.txt, so agents can follow the docs directly. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema was also retrieved unauthenticated, adding agent-consumable API docs. Missing for 10: no first-party guidance on using these docs with agents (e.g. an llms-full.txt or agent setup page), and no independent corroboration beyond probes.
